Commit d618ebaf0aa8 (""f2fs: enable small discard by default"") enables
f2fs to issue 4K size discard in real-time discard mode. However
smaller discard may cost more lifetime but releasing less free space in
flash device. Since f2fs has ability of separating hot/cold data and
garbage collection
column2: we can expect that small-sized invalid region would

column1: expand soon with OPU
column2: deletion or garbage collection on valid datas

column1: it's better to delay or skip issuing smaller size discards
to reduce overmuch consumption of IO bandwidth and lifetime of flash
storage.
This patch makes f2fs selectng 64K size as its default minimal
granularity
column2: and issue discard with the size which is not smaller than

column1: minimal granularity. Also it exposes discard granularity as sysfs entry
for configuration in different scenario.
